mapper.sql: id, group_id, group_name, group_description, parent_group_id, path, level, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO groups_info (group_id, group_name, group_description, parent_group_id, path, level, sort_order, status, create_time) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{groupName}, #{groupDescription}, #{parentGroupId}, #{path}, #{level}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 1), NOW());

INSERT INTO groups_info (group_id, group_name, group_description, parent_group_id, path, level, sort_order, status, create_time) SELECT #{groupId}, #{groupName}, #{groupDescription}, #{parentGroupId}, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.path, '/'), #{groupId}, '/'), CASE WHEN p.level IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE p.level + 1 END, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 1), NOW() FROM (SELECT 1) AS d LEFT JOIN groups_info p ON p.group_id = #{parentGroupId};
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM groups_info WHERE group_id = #{groupId}

SELECT FROM groups_info
AND group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{groupName}, '%')
AND parent_group_id = #{parentGroupId}
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, level ASC, create_time DESC
